> A concept page that opens with its definition and never names itself.

## What it is
The positive control for the missing-H1 half of the concept check. Every
required section from the [[SCHEMA]] template is present; the `# <Name>` line
is not.

## How we use it (project-specific!)
As the one page in this fixture that yields a `concept-missing-h1` error and
nothing else, so a test can assert the count rather than the presence.
